name: Swerve
rootCause: Defunct Swerve Finance still subject of $1.3 million live governance hack

descriptions.text: Defunct Swerve Finance still subject of $1.3 million live governance hack

Swerve Finance’s dormant Ethereum governance was targeted in March 2023 by a malicious proposal that sought about $1.3 million in stablecoins. The record supports a governance takeover attempt, but not a fully verified drain or final recovery total. Swerve kept treasury-moving governance alive after the protocol had become effectively inactive, so an actor could accumulate voting power and attempt a malicious proposal against the remaining assets. The evidence here does not independently establish a completed drain or any low-level contract bug.
